answer.rationale: Prioritize an expedited incumbent renewal negotiation: it preserves proven integration and delivery continuity while using market benchmarking and a multi-year volume commitment to pursue the mandated cost reduction and improved payment terms. A primary-vendor switch or second-source qualification would introduce avoidable delivery risk with the line at 94% utilization. Verify the prior benchmarking outcome before setting targets; do not assume an 18% reduction is achievable until current market comparisons are confirmed.
